notes.title: v1.1 - 7 October Update Is Online
notes.content:
We release our new update with major changes.Please play tutorial first for learn new controllers.

New Features:
+Lot AI enemies.
 [code] Now some enemies don't attack to you until they see you.Don't run on enemies.[/code]
+New locomotion system with Arm Swinger 
  [code] You can walk in areas with new locomotion system.We made lot test about motion sickness and we don't have any problem about it.[/code]
+Manor Textures are renewed. 
[code]We changed all textures in dark house scene.[/code]
+Tutorial textures are renewed.
+Manor lighting setup changed. 
[code]Dark house is not so dark anymore.We add some candles and torchs for lighting.[/code]
+Auto hand change problem solved. 
[code]Auto hand change still in game.But after you comple pickup/interaction it returns back to your weapon.[/code]
+New sword 
[code]We removed katana sword and add new sword.It's not shiny as katana and makes better hit on enemies.[/code]
+Better sword hit reaction 
+Explosive objects 
[code]Added some explosive objects for killing enemies.[/code]
+New horror items 
+Enemy hit box problems solved 
+Haptic feedbacks 
[code]Now you get haptic feedbacks for attack,shoot,low hp and sword damage situations. [/code]
+Gun light has wide angle and its white now. 
+New ammo places
[code]For finding magazines you have to search area and explode objects now. [/code]
+New breakable objects.
+Checkpoint problems solved 
+More distance attack enemies
+Little changes on map
+New enemy animations 
+Survival and Tutorial lighting setup renewed.
+Reduced minumum sword attack velocity.
+Some performance improvements.

-Removed sword wing sound.
-Removed sword trail. 
-Removed katana. 
-Removed mummy boss
-Removed some enemies from manorscene.
-Removed ice enemy born scream sound.


We really hope you like it.For better gaming experiance we listen all your feedback and try to solve it quickly.Thanks again for your feedbacks.

Please keep sharing.

Best Regards,
alkamegames.

notes.title: Smell of Death 5 Aug Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

Our latest update is online ! In this update we focus on the user experience.Please continue to share your feedback with us.

Changes in this update:

+ Mutant count is balanced 
+ New reload mechanic settings:
[code]We have two reload settings simple and realistic.In simple mode you just need to press grip button for reload.You can change reload mechanic from settings.The default reload mechanic is simple.[/code]
+ New diffuculty settings: 
[code]Mutant count and your health changes based on your diffuculty settings[/code]
+ New mutant sound
+ New mutant animations
+ Manor scene light is re-configured
+ Survival scene light is re-configured
+ Survival scene performance improved
+ Reduces minumum acceleration for sword attack
- Rifle removed:
[code]We are planning to make an update about loadout.With this users can select their loadout before start game.[/code]
- Hand clap sound is removed
- Hand is removed from gun swipe: 
[code]When you need to interact with something it changes automatically to hand.[/code]


Best Regards,
alkamegames.

notes.title: Smell of Death 17 July Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

Thanks for suggestions and feedbacks.We are listening all feedback and working on them.

Please use headphone for best experience.

Changes in this update:
- Now you can choose diffuculy level.Very easy, easy,normal and hard.
- 3D sound enabled.Now you can understand the direction of mutants.
- More quality graphics without performance loss.We make some tweak  for graphics.
- More big gun reload area.You can change magazines more easy.
- New High Quality mutant sounds with 3D.
- New HD gun sounds from Awarded sound studios.
- New FX Sounds.
- New Boss - Nefertiti Guardian
- 4 New Mutants - With this update you should look ground and air.We have 4 new mutants.2 type of spider,devil cat and flying mutant.
- More realistic hit reaction.
- Balance to mutants number.
- Ambission music volume has been lowered.

Known issues:
With OBS Records Dark House level loading can take up to 3 minutes.

Best Regars,
alkamegames.
